hero.description: From an academic foundation in English to professional translation, every step has shaped a deeper understanding of language, communication, and the responsibility behind every word.

history.desc: Earned a Bachelor of Arts and Education in English Language, Basic Education, building a strong academic foundation in language, communication, and English studies.
Developed practical experience in customer communication, active listening, problem-solving, and understanding client needs in a fast-paced professional environment.
Providing professional Arabic–English and English–Arabic translation across legal, medical, financial, and literary content, with a focus on accuracy, clarity, terminology, and context.
